clue.text: Gust around summit almost causes delay

clue.text: Disheartened indifferent US soldier with a nervous disorder

clue.text: Square opening, partly round

clue.text: Help to keep Rudolph’s nose dry

the first letter of the reindeer's name

clue.text: University somehow gained odd bits of land without any agreement?

the letters as printed
the first and third letters

first and last letters of the hyphenated word

clue.text: Edgbaston extremely happy to host new national team

clue.text: Bard finally enters piece to improve Kipling poem

the final letter
